description.narrative: The project aims at strengthened Kosovo dairy sector by improving productivity, milk quality, and resilience, while empowering farmer organizations, women, and youth. The following 5 expected results are target to be achieved by end of 2028: i)KAMP provides sustainable advisory and advocacy services to its members and KLDP becomes a recognized and institutionalized policy dialogue platform, ii)Inclusive and equitable food systems create sustainable job opportunities and livelihood options for women, youth, and smallholder farmers in the livestock sectors, iii) Increased productivity of the dairy farmers and improved compliance of the Milk Collection Points (MCPs) with EU quality standards, iv) Climate adaptation practices adopted by the increased number of dairy farmers to mitigate the impact of droughts and feed shortages, and v) Women and youth in the dairy sector increased their participation and leadership in farmer organizations and value chains.
